sources.title: Divergent Morphology among Populations of the New Guinea Crocodile, Crocodylus novaeguineae (Schmidt, 1928): Diagnosis of an Independent Lineage and Description of a New Species
sources.scope: Comparison of cranial and external morphology among northern and southern New Guinea populations, with a new-species description; supports diagnosis of sampled groups, not complete population ecology or range-wide abundance.
sources.attribution: Murray CM, Russo P, Zorrilla A, McMahan CD (2019). Divergent Morphology among Populations of the New Guinea Crocodile, Crocodylus novaeguineae (Schmidt, 1928): Diagnosis of an Independent Lineage and Description of a New Species. Copeia 107(3):517–523. DOI 10.1643/CG-19-240. Claims are paraphrased.

claims.text: Geometric morphometric comparison identified a southern New Guinea crocodile population group with cranial differences from northern populations, supporting its description as Crocodylus halli.
claims.scope: Diagnosis is tied to the compared specimens and localities; not a complete survey of island-wide ecological or population variation.

gaps: No multi-source species dossier is added.
The study's geographic and specimen samples do not represent every New Guinea river system or population.
